headline: Coca-Cola HBC Secondary Listing Debuts on JSE With R17.6 Billion South Africa Capex Plan
summary: Bottling giant Coca-Cola HBC completed its secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange while committing R17.6 billion in South African investment.
why: Coca-Cola HBC is one of the world's largest Coca-Cola anchor bottlers operating across Europe and Africa.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola HBC
impacts.why: The anchor bottler secondary listed on the JSE and announced R17.6 billion in domestic capital plans.
